steps: 1. Record the implementation plan at docs/plans/accounting-p12-benchmark-plan.md and maintain P12/progress.md. Preserve the recovery finding and map each work unit to MC28/MC33/MC35. The skeptical audit identifies circular reference construction, exposed source families, dependent observations, inherited calendar conventions and page-count capacity claims as material risks; the controls below address them. Record the research intent, evidence contract, defaults audit and pre-mortem before measurements. A mismatched source/reference hash or broken scorer vetoes dependent evaluation; a candidate failure triggers diagnosis without changing its reference answer.

2. Add scripts/accounting_benchmark_v1.py, scripts/check_accounting_p12.py, docs/design/fixtures/p12-benchmark-inputs-v1.json and tests/test_accounting_p12.py. Keep existing component APIs unchanged unless a separately documented defect requires repair. Implement preparation and evaluation as separate invocations: preparation writes the protocol, references and hashes into benchmark.json; evaluation verifies those hashes and appends observed results. Store supporting structured records inside the declared benchmark.json rather than creating undeclared supervisor-directory files.

3. Prepare four source-reference records: Apple annual assets, interim assets, the fiscal-calendar interpretation, and unidentified debt/swap allocation. Use P02 anchors to locate original evidence, then check the actual passages independently. Preserve raw literal, page/printed-page distinction, exact locator, original/extraction hashes, entity, perimeter, period, currency, scale, precision, basis, alternative readings and unresolved questions. Use the existing annotation schema for source records, with task-specific admissibility in a separate wrapper. Missing support remains unresolved and blocks scoring that record. These four records demonstrate reference preparation, not source-extraction accuracy.

4. Create a nine-family exposure and split register from the frozen panel/protocol. Retain development roles for Apple, Caterpillar, HSBC and SAIC; validation-candidate roles for Henkel and Midea; test-candidate roles for JPMorgan, Ping An and Munich Re. Record substantive development exposure and source acquisition/QA exposure separately, adding current annotation exposure. Keep every year, language, mirror and revision within its issuer family. Audit exact byte duplicates using retained-version hashes and record known document/table relationships; mark semantic duplicate coverage incomplete. Explicitly disclose the finance/insurance concentration, eight-year dependence and absence of clean unseen-model evidence.

5. Freeze a 12-case T3 chronology task for subtract_cumulative: three valid exact-rational cases covering ordinary subtraction, negative residual and matched revised observations; nine invalid cases covering instant input, concept mismatch, context mismatch, unsupported calendar, different starts, nonnested endpoints, unknown revision, incompatible revisions and incorrectly scoped revision exception. Derive amounts and periods manually with Fraction arithmetic and specify rejection requirements from the stated contract before execution. Denominators are 12 overall, 3 valid and 9 invalid. Score whole-case conformance with field diagnostics; missing output, malformed output, crash, timeout or unexpected abstention fails its case. Correct refusal passes only designated invalid cases. No post-result exclusion or reference repair without a new version and rerun.

6. Exercise a bounded T5 workload through rational_solver_v1. Build three synthetic rational-linear problems with 1, 3 and 5 binary choices, an exact weighted-sum output and an explicit upper-bound constraint. Freeze domains, weights, thresholds and expected feasible assignments using an independent standard-library exhaustive enumerator. Compare complete assignment/output sets, not only one witness or an optimum. Measure actual input facts, variables, labelled and generated constraints, formula nodes, potential/explored/retained branches and serialized input/output bytes. Add one deliberately insufficient search-budget case and one unsupported-fragment case with predeclared partial/unsupported outcomes. Keep these five workload cells separate from the 12 chronology cases.

7. For each workload cell, run three measured repetitions in fresh, synchronous child processes, sequentially, with a 10-second per-run timeout and a 180-second aggregate ceiling. Record perf_counter wall time, process CPU time, peak RSS with platform units and Python allocation peak; do not describe Python allocations as total memory. Declare every solver Budget field explicitly in preparation, including formula, assignment, cell, time and solver limits. Reconcile resource-limit responses with unresolved coverage. Treat repetition timings as descriptive only. Compare the solver and independent enumerator on identical mathematical inputs for correctness; do not claim a performance ranking. A tiny import/workload smoke check first detects interpreter, Z3 and process-support mismatches.

8. Write actual benchmark.json and result.md with the reference inventory, readiness decisions, difficult-case inventory, all per-case outcomes, counts, measurements and missing evidence. Include a manifest with command, interpreter/package versions, CPU-only status, input/code hashes, plan/reference hashes, wall time, changed files and git provenance only if verifiable without repository changes. Include decision and inference-status tables: finite conformance is the primary criterion; source/reference corruption, lost branches and false completeness are vetoes; timings are explanatory. Report zero stochastic ranking evidence, no default-readiness conclusion, strongest alternative explanations and next internal repairs. Stop measurements early enough to execute checks and preserve failures before the worker's reserved final interval.
plan.summary: Plan a bounded benchmark with four provisional source-reference records, a fixed 12-case chronology evaluation, and five measured rational-linear workload cells. Preserve nine-family exposure and dependence, freeze references before scoring, and separate engineering conformance from accounting or statistical validity.
